title: Generalized Stochastic Approximation of the Log-Likelihood Ratio for Robust Sequential Change-Point Detection
summary: Generalized stochastic approximation replaces the log-likelihood ratio of a sequential change-point problem by an affine function of a fixed feature dictionary, whose coefficients solve a normal system in the dictionary's moments under the pre- and post-change laws. The increment is a rescaled orthogonal projection of the bounded score, and the information it carries is bounded by the triangular discrimination between the laws.
